txt_en: Always remember that you are absolutely unique. Just like everyone else.
txt_cn: 永远记住你是独一无二的，就像其他人一样。
author: Margaret Mead

txt_en: The only way to have a friend is to be one.
txt_cn: 获得朋友的唯一方法是成为别人的朋友。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

txt_en: The best love is the kind that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more.
txt_cn: 最好的爱，唤醒我们的灵魂，让我们更有追求。
author: Nicholas Sparks

txt_en: Life is the sum of all your choices.
txt_cn: 你做的所有抉择造就了你的人生。
author: Albert Camus

txt_en: Where there is ruin, there is hope for a treasure.
txt_cn: 凡是有废墟的地方，就有可能藏着宝藏。
author: Jalaluddin Rumi

txt_en: The power of imagination makes us infinite.
txt_cn: 想象力让我们突破极限。
author: John Muir

txt_en: Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice.
txt_cn: 不要让他人意见的杂音淹没了自己的心声。
author: Steve Jobs

txt_en: Action may not always bring happiness; but there is no happiness without action.
txt_cn: 行动不一定能带来快乐，但不行动一定不能。
author: Benjamin Disraeli

txt_en: There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.
txt_cn: 成功没有诀窍。成功是筹备，苦干以及在失败中汲取教训的结果。
author: Colin L. Powell

txt_en: You can't help getting older, but you don't have to get old.
txt_cn: 你无法阻止衰老，但你不一定要变老。
author: George Burns

txt_en: I walk slowly, but I never walk backward.
txt_cn: 我走得慢，但从不后退。
author: Abraham Lincoln

txt_en: There is no chance, no destiny, no fate, that can hinder or control the firm resolve of a determined soul.
txt_cn: 对于下定决心的人来说，任何机遇、命数或运气都无法阻挠、控制其意志。
author: Ella Wheeler Wilcox

txt_en: Vitality shows in not only the ability to persist but the ability to start over.
txt_cn: 顽强的生命力不仅仅体现在坚持的力量，还有重新来过的能力。
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

txt_en: The difference between stupidity and genius is that genius has its limits.
txt_cn: 愚蠢和天赋的区别在于，天赋是有极限的。
author: Albert Einstein

txt_en: Knowledge is of no value unless you put it into practice.
txt_cn: 只有付诸实践，知识才有价值。
author: Anton Chekhov

txt_en: How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
txt_cn: 我们如何度过每一天，当然也就会如何度过一生。
author: Annie Dillard

txt_en: The most alluring thing a woman can have is confidence.
txt_cn: 女性的最迷人之处，就是拥有自信。
author: Beyoncé Giselle Knowles-Carter

txt_en: Difficulties increase the nearer we get to the goal.
txt_cn: 我们越接近目标，就会遇到越多困难。
author: Goethe

txt_en: It has been my observation that most people get ahead during the time that others waste.
txt_cn: 据我观察，大多数人都是在他人浪费光阴时，实现赶超领先的。
author: Henry Ford

txt_en: Happiness often sneaks in through a door you didn't know you left open.
txt_cn: 幸福，往往从你不经意间打开的门中不期而至。
author: John Barrymore

txt_en: Knowledge has to be improved, challenged, and increased constantly, or it vanishes.
txt_cn: 知识需要不断被改进、挑战和积累，否则将不复存在。
author: Peter Drucker

txt_en: He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
txt_cn: 知生命之意者，可承生命之重。
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

txt_en: I didn't set out to beat the world; I just set out to do my absolute best.
txt_cn: 我并没有打算打败世界，我只是全力以赴。
author: Shaun White

txt_en: Great achievement is usually born of great sacrifice, and is never the result of selfishness.
txt_cn: 伟大的成就大多来自于伟大的牺牲，决不是来自于自私自利。
author: Napoleon Hill

txt_en: Guard well your thoughts when alone and your words when accompanied.
txt_cn: 独处守住心，群处守住嘴。
author: Roy T. Bennett

txt_en: I call architecture frozen music.
txt_cn: 我称建筑为凝结的音乐。
author: 歌德
